Title: True canonical dependency model closure
Purpose: Remove legacy dependency mirrors from the core Process model and keep any old-format compatibility strictly at import/export boundaries.
Deliverables: Core Process entity/editor/runtime models that expose only canonical dependency collections/rows.
Versioned compatibility DTOs/adapters for old import/export payloads if backward compatibility is still required.
Removal of `FirstOrDefault()` single-dependency shortcuts from runtime projections and UI consumption paths.
Fresh tests proving old envelope compatibility does not reintroduce core dual representation.
ReviewQuestions: Is there now exactly one dependency representation inside the core module types?
Is old-format compatibility isolated to explicit boundary adapters instead of bridges on core models?
Did runtime/UI paths stop depending on a single-primary-dependency shortcut?
CorrectiveOnFailure: If any legacy dependency mirror remains on a core entity/editor/runtime type, or if compatibility still mutates core models, fail the gate and open the canonicality corrective playbook first.
